name: test-file-outside-every-configuration
description: A test file the test-file patterns name that no configuration of a derived matrix holds is analyzed in the configuration of the nearest compiler configuration file at or above it, as a file that configuration's file list names, because the test runner compiles it with those options. Its references count as test references and its parts are judged, so a production function only it calls is reported as test-only use and a local it never reads is reported as a dead store.
